svg.title: Momee — Mom head and hair prototype v1 (Soft Storybook Adventure)
svg.desc: M1.1b-1 candidate prototype: Mom's face, head and hairstyle as editable vector paths, recreated from the master reference projects/momee/styles/soft-storybook-adventure/references/momee-soft-storybook-master-reference-v1.png (SHA-256 907a9bd82ed5aec0fe7f50c0494bcdda1d74fddf59a1d51c2b07cd34fb77dd36). Status: candidate for owner review; not visually accepted, not production-approved. Groups: hair-back, neck-preview, head (ears, face-base, shading, blush, nose), facial-features (eyebrows, eyes, mouth), hair-front, highlights. Candidate pivots (not a rig): head joint about (387, 470); eye centres (321, 337) and (454, 339); mouth centre (387, 410).
